card.title: PlayStation 4 Motherboard Component and Circuit Identification Diagram

source.title: PlayStation 4 Motherboard Component and Circuit Map

claims.statement: Shows locations of APU, power phases for CPU, GPU, and RAM, ports, and key ICs on the PlayStation 4 motherboard.
claims.evidence: Annotated callouts pointing to APU, HDMI 2.0 port, power circuits, and various connectors.

card.caveats: This image shows component locations and circuit blocks, but does not provide voltage values or diode reading measurements.
